title: ZequePack
description: ZequePack is a user-friendly, beautiful modpack with optimization.
body: # 📃 Introduction _**My build includes various modifications ranging from optimising the game to adding some nice tweaks to the vanilla version.**_ In addition to mods, my pack includes useful/beautiful resource packs and shaders. I recommend leaving resource packs because they do not contribute anything supernatural, but only complement the game interface, such as [Default Dark Mode](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/default-dark-mode) and [Icons](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/icons). And if you have a medium pc, then you can easily install shaders that are disabled by default. To enable them, you need to go to the graphics settings and see the "Shaders" button on the top right, where you will see the initially pre-installed shaders. Initially, this mod pack was created for personal use, but after that I started sharing it with my friends and uploaded it here to make it easier. # ⭐ Features ### ⚡️ Performance Increase This modpack enhanced with optimizations for improved FPS and reduced PC load. A perfect solution for smooth gameplay, even on low-end devices! ### 🔧 OptiFine Features It can safely support almost all OptiFine functions, despite the fact that the build is based on [Sodium](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium).
